text:
deploy-bot: Starting schema migration `add_order_status_enum` on prod - window 23:00-23:30 UTC. job_id=deploy-7812
alex: heads-up: this backfill touches orders.status for ~120M rows, might exceed 20m runtime
maria: noted. plan is: 1) add enum type 2) add column orders.status_new default 'pending' 3) backfill in batches 4) swap names
priya: can we do batched UPDATE with `WHERE id % 1000 = <shard>` to parallelize?
ken: +1. but watch for index bloat. prefer COPY-to-temp and swap if we can
sam: if backfill > 15m we should cut to canary and pin release. rollback plan: `psql -c "ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS status_new"` and revert app flag
alex: deploy-bot, can you set a holdpoint after step 2 (before heavy backfill)? want manual ok
deploy-bot: Holdpoint created at step=2 by @deploy-bot, action_required=@maria
maria: i'll watch. set DB throttle to 1000 rows/sec and enable `disable_triggers`=false
priya: i'll open runbook note in release notes: release/2026.03.21-order-status-enum
ken: if locks escalate, fallback is online swap with view mapping old->new enum until full fill
sam: also pin graph-api to v2.14.0 for the window to avoid enum mismatch
alex: one more: schedule short read-only quiesce on payment-worker queue for 30s during swap
maria: ack. rollback criteria: - replication lag > 5m OR deadlocks > 10 in 5m OR backfill progress stalls > 25%/10m
priya: I'll run the staged job with `pgbench` profile locally first
deploy-bot: Step 2 complete: type and column added. waiting for manual continue. logs:
```
INFO: created enum order_status (pending,processing,shipped,returned)
INFO: added column status_new DEFAULT 'pending'
```
alex: continue approved. starting batched backfill in 10s :rocket:
ken: monitor index bloat and CPU on writer nodes
sam: if we hit rollback criteria, i'll flip canary flag and start revert job
maria: thanks team. will post a short release notes blurb after swap: "Orders: add status enum with online backfill; no user-facing changes"
priya: noted, will attach perf graphs
sam: :thumbsup:
